### A Prayer for Faith Like Caleb to Climb Your New Mountain
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-faith-like-caleb-to-climb-your-new-mountain.html
Passage: Numbers 14:24
Points:
- Daunting life trials can easily appear as overwhelming as impassable mountains.
- Unlike his fearful companions, Caleb viewed huge obstacles through eyes of faith.
- Having a different spirit means choosing total trust instead of anxiety.
- Overcoming fear requires stepping forward and relying on God's limitless power.
- Trusting the Lord through adversity builds a legacy that inspires others.

### A Different Attitude
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-february-1-2024.html
Passage: Numbers 14:24
Points:
- Caleb endured decades in the wilderness without giving in to popular discontent.
- He stayed spiritually vibrant into old age by believing God's promises.
- Rather than demanding comfort, Caleb eagerly embraced the difficult challenge of Hebron.
- He prioritized deep communion with the Lord over earthly self-indulgence.
- Believers are called to resist crowd mentality and fully trust God's word.
